title: Repeat success for 1 cycles
expected: the final installed identity equals the final authenticated fixture identity
the number of unresolved owned network operations equals 0
each successful manual recovery has exactly 1 closure transition
the final mounted listener and timer counts equal the recorded mounted baseline

assertions.name: mounted listener count returns to baseline
mounted timer count returns to baseline

limits: Actual Chromium portal, React hooks, reducers, Axios interceptors and services.
Controlled browser time, synthetic identity and auth responses. Protected peer assertions are fixture-level, not production RSA authorization.
Native device, VPN, real sleep, independent devices and unavailable target boundaries remain blocked.
Native CDP counts listeners on window, document, and all mounted elements. Detached targets and garbage collection are outside this mounted-count predicate.
